title: Create neutral-fusion palette and tactile gap system for dataviz
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Summary:
We need a compact, perceptually-uniform neutral palette plus a tactile gap/spacing scale and a proportional radius step system specifically tuned for dense data surfaces (tables, mini-charts, panes). The goal is to reduce visual noise in dashboards, improve legibility of data rows and sparklines, and provide token names that can be safely used by engineers and product teams without per-component overrides.

Goals:
- Introduce a neutral 'fusion' palette (fusion-0 .. fusion-900) built in OKLab/CAM02-UCS to preserve consistent perceived contrast across light/dark themes.
- Provide 6-base spacing/gap steps optimized for high-density layouts (4px, 8px, 12px, 16px, 20px, 28px) with semantic tokens (gap.xs..gap.lg).
- Define a proportional radius scale (r-0, r-1, r-2, r-3) mapped to tactile components: chips, table-cells, panels, modals.
- Replace ad-hoc shadows with a micro-elevation system (elev.micro, elev.small, elev.medium) with numeric token overlays for opacity and blur so infra can map to platform renderers.
- Provide migration guidance and automated codemods to convert old token names to new ones for tables and chart containers.

Design decisions / trade-offs considered:
- Color space: we chose OKLab for interpolation to avoid hue-shift artifacts in neutrals (tested against CAM02-UCS; OKLab produced fewer mid-tone drift issues in our test set).
- Number of steps: opted for a 10-step neutral ramp to allow fine-grained contrasts for separators, row zebra, and backgrounds while keeping dev cognitive load low.
- Spacing scale: selected a hybrid 4/8 base to support existing 8px baseline but allow tighter 4px gutters for dense datagrids.
- Radius mapping: prioritized tactile affordance for touch (mobile) and compactness for desktop tables.
- Shadows: simplified from 12 variance presets to 3 composable layers to reduce GPU cost on animated panels.

Acceptance criteria:
- Figma token library updated and exported to token package (tokens.fusion.* / gap.* / radius.* / elev.*).
- Visual QA checklist: contrast ratios validated for text-on-background and UI-on-background across fusion steps (WCAG AA where applicable for interactive elements).
- Migration plan with codemod ready and tested on a sample repo converting at least 75% of table/panel usages without manual edits.
- Frontend implementation PR compiles and demo app renders both light and dark theme with no layout regressions.

Token naming examples (proposal):
- color.neutral.fusion-050 .. color.neutral.fusion-900
- spacing.gap-xxs (4) / gap-xs (8) / gap-sm (12) / gap-md (16) / gap-lg (20) / gap-xl (28)
- radius.none (0) / radius.small (4) / radius.rounded (8) / radius.container (12)
- elevation.micro (layered tokens: elev.micro-0, elev.micro-1) / elevation.small / elevation.medium

Migration steps:
1) Publish Figma library and token spec to Confluence (link below).
2) Release token package (npm) under @redwood-design/tokens with minor version.
3) Add codemod script in frontend monorepo to rename legacy tokens (e.g., neutral-100 -> fusion-200 mapping table).
4) Run on staging apps and open PRs with diffs; resolve styling regressions (if any) in design review.
5) Announce migration window and opt-in feature flag for 2 release cycles before enforced switch.

Open questions / risks:
- Do we need an extended fusion ramp (20 steps) for chart fill gradients? (engineering prefers fewer tokens).
- How should theme overrides for customers (private deployment) be surfaced—allow direct token overrides or provide a theme bridge?
- Accessibility: ensure separators and gridlines still meet perceptual detection for low-vision users; may require extra contrast for table row dividers.
comments: 2025-02-14 - Aisha Patel: Initial spike complete. OKLab interpolation yielded the smoothest mid-tone progression in our sample dashboards (see figma test frames). Recommend committing to OKLab unless engineering has a strong preference for CAM02.

2025-02-19 - Luca Moreno: Implemented prototype tokens in the token package branch. Ran visual snapshot tests for 6 dashboard pages. Two failures in datagrid zebra rows — contrast adjustment to fusion-100 suggested. Attaching PR.

2025-02-21 - Kai Chen (Engineering review): PR feedback: prefer token names without dots in package exports (use fusion_050 style for JS exports). Also asked for numeric alias map for runtime mapping. Added as follow-up task.

2025-02-25 - Maya Singh (Accessibility): Reviewed contrast matrix. Interactive row actions meet AA at fusion-300 foreground, but static labels need fusion-500 in dark theme. Recommended adding 'text-on-muted' alias tokens.
2025-03-01 - Design review (Luca/Aisha/Maya): Decided on final spacing steps and radius mapping. Agreed to 10-step fusion ramp and 6-step gap scale. Aisha to update Figma and export tokens.

2025-03-04 - Luca Moreno: Frontend PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1234. Hooked tokens into theme provider and added feature flag to toggle legacy token set. Visual regression dashboard: dashboard.internal.redwood/shots/tokens/fusion.
notes: Follow-up tasks: create codemod docs, add migration checklist to release notes, schedule cross-team demo during design sync (2025-03-10).
